text:
sam-partnerships: quick heads up: HeliosSystems is rejecting marketplace POs for TE-ACCEL-64 unless the PO includes an ECCN (export control classification) code and a linked Export License reference. They say customs won't clear without it.

lorna-procurement: ECCN? we don't currently emit ECCN in the 850. we have an internal product attribute but it doesn't flow to EDI.

ben-ops: do they want a specific segment? example they sent: `SEG|X-ECCN|ECCN:5A992|LIC:EL-2026-44`

sam-partnerships: yes that's what they require. warehouse gate will reject otherwise. impact: 3 pending POs for EU customers.

anya-sales: customers are pinging for ETA. this will delay shipments if we can't resolve in 48h.

omar-legal: legal flag 1: including ECCN is fine, but referencing export licenses requires careful retention and possibly special access controls. also check whether putting license IDs in the clear in EDI is acceptable. I can ask export-control counsel.

edi-bot: Automated: PO 2027-02-01-HS-307 created (status: pending). SKUs: TE-ACCEL-64 x4.

ben-ops: options: (A) vendor-mapping to emit `X-ECCN` for HeliosSystems and reissue POs (needs vendor ack), (B) include ECCN as a dedicated PO line `ECCN-CODE` with description `ECCN:5A992 LIC:EL-2026-44` (workaround), (C) send license as separate secure SFTP artefact and put a pointer segment `LICREF:EL-2026-44` (preferred if vendor agrees).

lorna-procurement: mapping + reissue is doable, ETA 3 business days including signoff. re-transmit risks duplicate processing unless vendor acknowledges.

anya-sales: can we ask Helios to accept `LICREF` pointer instead of full license? less PII surface.

sam-partnerships: I'm drafting ask: accept either `X-ECCN`+`LICREF` in 850 or accept email/SFTP with license and `LICREF` referencing the PO. If no response by EOD tomorrow, we'll apply the `ECCN-CODE` PO-line workaround and tag for reconciliation.

omar-legal: I'll check with export counsel on storing license ids and whether `LICREF` is sufficient. also drafting a non-amendment clause to avoid attachments changing terms.

ben-ops: note to @oncall-fulfillment: the temporary PO-line hack will create noise in invoice matching; we plan to add a `RECONCILE:EXEMPT` marker to avoid false duplicates.

sam-partnerships: thanks all. looping in Helios liaison now. will update when they confirm preferred flow. keeping this thread for audit. :white_check_mark:
